# Universal Web Foundation

Start with AGENTS.md and FOUNDATION_MANIFEST.yaml. UWF is a Foundation-first planning and governance workspace for web projects. Application code is prohibited until the relevant implementation gate is approved.

Documentation:
- README.md — human installation and overview
- Foundation/README.md — Foundation stage map
- Foundation/00-Control — questions, decisions, risks, and change records
- Foundation/14-Change-Management — reviewable scope changes, impact analysis, and release backlog
- Foundation/06-UX-UI — optional creative brief, responsive/accessibility review, and simulation plan
- Foundation/00-Control/Capability-Matrix.md — honest workflow maturity and known limits
- Foundation/06-UX-UI/Design-Reference-Registry.md and Reference-Analysis.md — clean-room UI/UX reference analysis
- Foundation/12-Handover/Release-Readiness.md — evidence before calling an implementation release stable
- templates/ — reusable specifications and review formats
- docs/ — beginner, professional, automation, and migration guides

Terminal-agent workflow: read AGENTS.md and FOUNDATION_MANIFEST.yaml, then use `uwf context --json`, `uwf status --json`, `uwf next --json`, and `uwf validate --json`. Never implement application code before the developer approves the implementation gate.

Use `uwf template list` for original Foundation starter packs, `uwf reference` before using external references, `uwf capability` before promising a capability, and `uwf release check` before describing an implementation release as stable.
